title: Dan Gurney, 1931-2018
content: Very sad to know that race driver, car builder, team owner (and my cousin) Dan Gurney died today from complications of pneumonia. I'll miss his courage, tenacity, kindness, and humor.-----Biography on Racer.comPrevious Posts:Painting Dan Gurney's Pepsi ChallengerThe Delta Wing at LeMansDan Gurney at the Indy 500
